# Chat agents (non-Zoom) messaging protocol reference

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

HTTP protocol reference for integrating chat agents (non-Zoom) with Zoom Contact Center. This protocol defines the message format and endpoints that chat agent providers implement to support action and trigger mode integration.

The integration enables chat agents (non-Zoom) to act as AI agents within Zoom Contact Center, handling conversation messages, rich media content, and handover to live agents.

For the full integration workflow and Marketplace app setup, see [Integrate chat agents (non-Zoom) with actions and triggers](/docs/contact-center/library/guides/chatbot/).

## Send messages to the chat agent

To send messages from Zoom Contact Center to your chat agent endpoint, Zoom sends HTTP requests with the following payload structure.

### Request payload

```json
{
    "id": "xxx",
    "sessionId": "xxx",
    "conversationMode": "START_CONVERSATION",
    "message": {
        "type": "text",
        "value": "hi"
    },
    "conversationVariables": {
        "global_system.Engagement.timezone": "America/New_York",
        "global_system.Engagement.regionCode": "GA",
        "global_system.Consumer.email": "a@q.com",
        "global_system.Engagement.latLong": "34.0409, -84.0237",
        "global_custom.CustomerVariableGroup.QueueOpenHours": "1698872160000",
        "global_custom.CustomerVariableGroup.CVariable001": "this is default value",
        "global_system.Engagement.locale": "en-us",
        "global_custom.Website_Data_Value.GJavescriptVariable_hostname": "localhost",
        "global_system.Engagement.regionName": "Georgia",
        "global_system.Engagement.cityName": "Suwanee"
    },
    "languageCode": "en-US",
    "additionalPayload": null,
    "timestamp": 111,
    "userId": "xxx",
    "customData": {
        "trackingId": "xxx",
        "engagmentId": "xxx"
    }
}
```

### Request parameters

| Parameter Name        | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Possible Values                                               |
| --------------------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id                    | String | Yes      | Unique identifier for this request.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                               |
| sessionId             | String | Yes      | Unique identifier for the chat agent conversations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                               |
| conversationMode      | String | Yes      | Parameter to define whether to start a new conversion, continue with the existing, or close the conversation.`START_CONVERSATION`: starts a session `KEEP_CONVERSATION`: keeps the current session. `END_CONVERSATION`: ends the current session                                 | `START_CONVERSATION`, `KEEP_CONVERSATION`, `END_CONVERSATION` |
| conversationVariables | Object | No       | Will be sent only once when `conversationMode` is `START_CONVERSATION`. Include both system-defined and customer-defined values. Chat agent providers should store these variables within the conversation context so that customers can reference within the chat agent's flow. |                                                               |
| additionalPayload     | Object | No       | For submissions of forms, cards, action cards, or quick replies, the data will be placed in the `additionalPayload` field. **Note**: `additionalPayload` may be null if the consumer's input is not related to any of these rich media selections.                               |                                                               |
| languageCode          | String | Yes      | Required when `conversationMode` is `START_CONVERSATION` or `KEEP_CONVERSATION`.                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `en-US`                                                       |
| message               | Object | Yes      | Details of the message to be sent.Required when `conversationMode` is `START_CONVERSATION` or `KEEP_CONVERSATION`.                                                                                                                                                               |                                                               |
| timestamp             | Long   | Yes      | Unix epoch time when the message was sent from the end-user of the chat client.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                                                               |
| userId                | String | Yes      | Unique user identifier. This is the identifier of the end-user who is interacting with the chat agent.                                                                                                                                                                           |                                                               |
| customData            | Object | Yes      | Pass-through JSON-formatted name-value pairs that are sent back in the response. These values are not processed by the endpoint, but can be used to keep specific customer information attached to the conversation.                                                             |                                                               |

### Message input types

#### Text

To handle plain text messages from consumers, parse the message object.

```json
{
    "type": "text",
    "value": "Hi, I need some help!"
}
```

| Field | Required | Value  | Description | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | ----------- | ---------- |
| value | Yes      | String | Plain text  | n/a        |

## Receive messages from the chat agent

To respond with messages from your chat agent to Zoom Contact Center, return HTTP responses with the following payload structure.

### Response payload

Basic response example.

```json
{
    "id": "xxx",
    "sessionId": "xxx",
    "body": [
        {
            "type": "text",
            "value": "Hi, I'm your virtual agent!"
        }
    ],
    "timestamp": 111,
    "userId": "xxx",
    "completed": false,
    "customData": {
        "trackingId": "xxx",
        "engagmentId": "xxx"
    }
}
```

### Response parameters

| Parameter Name | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Possible Values |
| -------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- |
| id             | String  | Yes      | Unique identifier for this request.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| sessionId      | String  | No       | Unique identifier for the chat agent conversations.                                                                                                                                                                                               |                 |
| body           | Array   | Yes      | List of objects that describe the elements of the response message body.                                                                                                                                                                          |                 |
| timestamp      | Long    | Yes      | Unix epoch time when the message was sent from the end-user of the chat client.                                                                                                                                                                   |                 |
| userId         | String  | Yes      | Unique user identifier. This is the identifier of the end-user who is interacting with the chat agent.                                                                                                                                            |                 |
| completed      | Boolean | No       | Flag that indicates whether the chat agent has successfully completed the conversation. `true` means conversation has been successfully completed. `false` means conversation is not complete and this parameter is not returned in the response. | `true`, `false` |
| customData     | Object  | Yes      | Pass-through JSON-formatted name-value pairs that are sent back in the response. These values are not processed by the endpoint, but can be used to keep specific customer information attached to the conversation.                              |                 |

### Message body structure

Each message in the `body` array contains a type and value.

| Field        | Required | Value  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Possible Values                                                                                                                              |
| ------------ | -------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| type         | Yes      | String | Message content type.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `action`, `text`, `html`, `markdown`, `quickReplies`, `card`, `carousel`, `article`, `image`, `audio`, `video`, `link`, `form`, `attachment` |
| value        | Yes      | Object | Refer to the message content types below.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                              |
| fallbackText | No       | String | When a chat agent is integrated with social channels such as Facebook or WhatsApp, these platforms may not fully support rich text messages. Setting a `fallbackText` helps ensure that users can still see a message instead of receiving no prompt at all. |                                                                                                                                              |

### Action

To trigger actions in the conversation, use action messages.

#### Set variables

To dynamically route to queues, set variables in the conversation context.

```json
{
    "type": "action",
    "value": {
        "action": "setVariables",
        "data": {
            "variables": [
                {
                    "name": "global_custom.dynamic routing.dynamical_queue",
                    "value": "Main Team Queue"
                }
            ]
        }
    }
}
```

> **Note**
>
> `global_custom` is the prefix used for custom-defined variables. `dynamic routing` is the variable group name. `dynamical_queue` is the variable name. The `value` field contains the queue name.

#### Typing indicator

To display a typing indicator, send a typing action.

```json
{
    "type": "action",
    "value": {
        "action": "typing",
        "data": {
            "typingTime": 1000
        }
    }
}
```

| Field      | Required | Value | Description                                                                                                         | Limitation |
| ---------- | -------- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| typingTime | No       | long  | Typing indicator display duration in milliseconds. If not specified, the default maximum display time is 5 seconds. | n/a        |

#### Transfer to live agent

To transfer the conversation to a live agent, send a transfer action.

```json
{
    "type": "action",
    "value": "TransferToLiveAgent"
}
```

### Article

To send an article with content and sources, use the article type.

```json
{
    "type": "article",
    "value": {
        "title": "How Zoom can help you stay safe in cyberspace",
        "content": "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><style>body {background-color: powderblue;}h1   {color: blue;}p    {color: red;}</style></head><body><h1>This is a heading</h1><p>This is a paragraph.</p></body></html>",
        "style": "multi-sources",
        "sources": [
            {
                "label": "reference 1",
                "title": "this is reference 1",
                "content": "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><style>body {background-color: powderblue;}h1   {color: blue;}p    {color: red;}</style></head><body><h1>This is a heading</h1><p>This is a paragraph.</p></body></html>",
                "contentType": "markdown",
                "url": "https://www.zoom.com/en/blog/how-zoom-can-help-you-stay-safe-in-cyberspace/"
            },
            {
                "label": "reference 2",
                "title": "this is reference 2",
                "contentType": "html",
                "content": "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><style>body {background-color: powderblue;}h1   {color: blue;}p    {color: red;}</style></head><body><h1>This is a heading</h1><p>This is a paragraph.</p></body></html>",
                "url": "https://www.zoom.com/en/blog/how-zoom-can-help-you-stay-safe-in-cyberspace/"
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

| Field   | Required | Value  | Description                                            | Limitation |
| ------- | -------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- |
| title   | Yes      | String | Article title                                          | 256 Bytes  |
| content | Yes      | String | Standard HTML format or plain text                     | n/a        |
| sources | Yes      | List   | List of article sources                                | 20         |
| style   | No       | String | Source display style: `single-source`, `multi-sources` | n/a        |

#### Article source

To add source references to an article, include source objects.

| Field       | Required | Value   | Description                               | Limitation |
| ----------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| label       | Yes      | String  | The button or label name                  | 128 Bytes  |
| title       | Yes      | String  | The title in the details                  | 256 Bytes  |
| content     | Yes      | String  | Standard HTML format or plain text        | n/a        |
| contentType | No       | String  | Content format type: `markdown` or `html` | n/a        |
| url         | No       | String  | The article link                          | n/a        |
| openNewTab  | No       | Boolean | The URL will open in new tab              | n/a        |

### Card

To send a card with an image, description, and action buttons, use the card type.

```json
{
    "type": "card",
    "value": {
        "title": "card title",
        "description": "This text is **bold**.",
        "imageUrl": "https://static-st1.zoomdev.us/static/6.3.34762/image/new/topNav/Zoom_logo.svg",
        "options": [
            {
                "type": "option",
                "label": "Select case 1",
                "value": "case1"
            },
            {
                "type": "link",
                "label": "More",
                "value": "https://example.com/link"
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

| Field       | Required | Value   | Description                                                                                                                                                                 | Limitation |
| ----------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| title       | No       | String  | Card title                                                                                                                                                                  | 256 Bytes  |
| description | No       | String  | Standard Markdown format                                                                                                                                                    | 4096 Bytes |
| imageUrl    | Yes      | String  | Image URL                                                                                                                                                                   | n/a        |
| options     | Yes      | List    | List of card options                                                                                                                                                        | 20         |
| mandatory   | No       | Boolean | If true, and the options list contains at least one option type item (button), the live chat client will disable the input box if the button is not clicked. Default: false | n/a        |

#### Card option types

**Option button**

To add an option button to a card, use type `option`.

| Field | Required | Value  | Description          | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | -------------------- | ---------- |
| type  | Yes      | String | `option`             |            |
| label | Yes      | String | Display name         | 128 Bytes  |
| value | Yes      | String | The identified value | n/a        |

**Link button**

To add a link button to a card, use type `link`.

| Field | Required | Value  | Description  | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | ------------ | ---------- |
| type  | Yes      | String | `link`       |            |
| label | Yes      | String | Display name | 128 Bytes  |
| value | Yes      | String | URL          | n/a        |

### Form

To collect information from consumers through a form, use the form type.

```json
{
    "type": "form",
    "value": {
        "name": "form name",
        "title": "form title",
        "subtitle": "I really like it ",
        "fields": [
            {
                "type": "text",
                "label": "Name",
                "key": "name",
                "required": true,
                "defaultValue": "name"
            },
            {
                "type": "single-select",
                "label": "Education",
                "key": "education",
                "required": true,
                "options": [
                    {
                        "label": "High School Diploma",
                        "value": "high_school"
                    },
                    {
                        "label": "Other",
                        "value": "other"
                    }
                ],
                "defaultValue": "high_school"
            },
            {
                "type": "multi-select",
                "label": "Make you chocie",
                "key": "option",
                "required": true,
                "options": [
                    {
                        "label": "Option1",
                        "value": "1"
                    },
                    {
                        "label": "Option2",
                        "value": "2"
                    },
                    {
                        "label": "Option3",
                        "value": "3"
                    }
                ],
                "defaultValue": ["1", "2"]
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

| Field     | Required | Value   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Limitation |
| --------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- |
| name      | No       | String  | Form name                                                                                                                                                                                                    |            |
| title     | No       | String  | Form title                                                                                                                                                                                                   | 256 Bytes  |
| subtitle  | No       | String  | Form subtitle                                                                                                                                                                                                | 1024 Bytes |
| mandatory | No       | Boolean | If true, and the field list contains at least one field element, the live chat client will disable the input box before the form has been submitted. Default: false. **Note**: Works with livechat SDK only. |            |
| fields    | Yes      | List    | List of form fields                                                                                                                                                                                          |            |

#### Text input field

To add a text input field to a form, use the text field type.

```json
{
    "type": "text",
    "label": "Name",
    "key": "name",
    "required": true,
    "defaultValue": "",
    "pattern": "text"
}
```

| Field        | Required | Value   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Limitation     |
| ------------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| label        | Yes      | String  | Field label                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | 128 Bytes      |
| key          | Yes      | String  | Field key                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 64 Bytes       |
| required     | No       | Boolean | Whether field is required                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |                |
| defaultValue | No       | String  | Default value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | 256 Bytes      |
| pattern      | No       | String  | Validation pattern: `text` (no rule)`email` (must be in email address format)`integer` (require input of positive integers)`decimal` (require decimal input)`custom` (use the regex set in field customRegex to do the validation). Default: text |                |
| customRegex  | No       | String  | Regular expression for custom pattern validation                                                                                                                                                                                                  | 128 characters |
| errorLabel   | No       | String  | The error message to show while the data is invalid                                                                                                                                                                                               | 128 characters |

> **Note**
>
> Maximum text input value length is 256 Bytes.

#### Select field

To add a single-select dropdown to a form, use the single-select field type.

```json
{
    "type": "single-select",
    "label": "Education",
    "key": "education",
    "required": true,
    "options": [
        {
            "label": "High School Diploma",
            "value": "high_school"
        },
        {
            "label": "Associate Degree",
            "value": "associate"
        },
        {
            "label": "Bachelor's Degree",
            "value": "bachelor"
        },
        {
            "label": "Doctoral Degree (Ph.D.)",
            "value": "doctor"
        },
        {
            "label": "Other",
            "value": "other"
        }
    ],
    "defaultValue": ""
}
```

| Field        | Required | Value   | Description               | Limitation |
| ------------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------- | ---------- |
| label        | Yes      | String  | Field label               | 128 Bytes  |
| key          | Yes      | String  | Field key                 | 128 Bytes  |
| required     | No       | Boolean | Whether field is required |            |
| defaultValue | No       | String  | Default option value      |            |
| options      | Yes      | List    | List of select options    |            |

**Select option**

Each option in a select field has the following structure.

```json
{
    "label": "Male",

}
```

| Field | Required | Value  | Description        | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | ------------------ | ---------- |
| label | Yes      | String | Display name       | 128 Bytes  |
| value | Yes      | String | The identify value | 128 Bytes  |

```json
        {
            "label": "Option2",
            "value": "2"
        },
        {
            "label": "Option3",
            "value": "3"
        }
    ],
    "defaultValues": ["1", "2"]
}
```

| Field        | Required | Value   | Description               | Limitation |
| ------------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------- | ---------- |
| label        | Yes      | String  | Field label               | 128 Bytes  |
| key          | Yes      | String  | Field key                 | 64 Bytes   |
| required     | No       | Boolean | Whether field is required |            |
| defaultValue | No       | List    | Default option values     |            |
| options      | Yes      | List    | List of select options    |            |

**Multi-select option**

Each option in a multi-select field has the following structure.

```json
{
    "label": "Male",
    "value": "male"
}
```

| Field | Required | Value  | Description                                                             | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| label | Yes      | String | Display name                                                            | 128 Bytes  |
| value | Yes      | String | The identify value. Only strings consisting of a-z and 0-9 are allowed. | 64 Bytes   |

### HTML

To send HTML-formatted messages, use the html type.

```json
{
    "type": "html",
    "value": "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Page Title</title></head><body><h1>HTML message</h1><a href=\"https://zoom.com\">Zoom</a><p><b>Please type your query below</b></p></body></html>"
}
```

| Field | Required | Value  | Description          | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | -------------------- | ---------- |
| value | Yes      | String | Standard HTML format | n/a        |

### Image

To send an image, use the image type.

```json
{
    "type": "image",
    "value": {
        "title": "image title",
        "width": 300,
        "height": 200,
        "name": "zoom_logo",
        "altText": "This is a logo",
        "url": "https://zoom.us/logo.jpeg"
    }
}
```

| Field   | Required | Value Type | Description                            | Limitation |
| ------- | -------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| url     | Yes      | String     | Image URL                              | n/a        |
| width   | No       | Number     | Image width                            | n/a        |
| height  | No       | Number     | Image height                           | n/a        |
| name    | No       | String     | Image name                             | 128 Bytes  |
| altText | No       | String     | Text displayed when hovering the mouse | 128 Bytes  |

### Link

To send a link, use the link type.

```json
{
    "type": "link",
    "value": {
        "label": "link name",
        "url": "https://zoom.us"
    }
}
```

| Field | Required | Value  | Description | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | ----------- | ---------- |
| url   | Yes      | String | Link URL    | n/a        |
| label | No       | String | Link label  | 128 Bytes  |

### Markdown

To send Markdown-formatted messages, use the markdown type.

```json
{
    "type": "markdown",
    "value": "## This text is **bold**."
}
```

| Field | Required | Value  | Description              | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | ------------------------ | ---------- |
| value | Yes      | String | Standard Markdown format | n/a        |

### Quick replies

To provide quick reply buttons for consumer responses, use the quickReplies type.

```json
{
    "type": "quickReplies",
    "value": {
        "title": "Please make your choice",
        "options": [
            {
                "label": "Yes",
                "type": "postback",
                "value": "yes"
            },
            {
                "label": "No",
                "type": "postback",
                "value": "no"
            }
        ],
        "mandatory": true
    }
}
```

| Field         | Required | Value   | Description                                                                                                         | Limitation |
| ------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| title         | Yes      | String  | Title text                                                                                                          | 1024 Bytes |
| options       | Yes      | List    | List of quick reply options                                                                                         | 20         |
| options.label | Yes      | String  | Display name                                                                                                        | 128 Bytes  |
| options.type  | Yes      | String  | Option type: `postback`, `phone_number`, `web_url`, `trigger_intent`                                                |            |
| options.value | Yes      | String  | The identified value                                                                                                | n/a        |
| mandatory     | No       | Boolean | If true, the live chat client will disable the input box when the quick reply button is not clicked. Default: false | n/a        |

### Text

To send plain text messages, use the text type.

```json
{
    "type": "text",
    "value": "Hi, I'm your virtual agent!"
}
```

| Field | Required | Value  | Description | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | ----------- | ---------- |
| value | Yes      | String | Plain text  | n/a        |

### Video

To send a video (YouTube), use the video type.

```json
{
    "type": "video",
    "value": {
        "title": "This is a title",
        "name": "video name",
        "url": "https://youtube.com/123456"
    }
}
```

| Field | Required | Value  | Description | Limitation |
| ----- | -------- | ------ | ----------- | ---------- |
| url   | Yes      | String | Video URL   | n/a        |
| title | No       | String | Video title | 128 Bytes  |
| name  | No       | String | Video name  | 128 Bytes  |
